instructions:
1. Set the suspension handles to about knee height and place your feet in them, hands under your shoulders in a push-up position.
2. Keep your body straight from head to heels and brace your core.
3. Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the floor, then press back up.
4. At the top, rotate your body to one side, stacking your feet and reaching the top arm to the ceiling in a side plank.
5. Return to the push-up position, then alternate the side plank to the other side.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Use a non-slip surface so your hands stay planted.
2. Move slowly through the rotation to keep your hips from dropping.
3. Exhale as you press up and during the rotation.
4. Keep your core braced throughout to protect your spine.
name: Suspension Trainer with Grips Push-up to Side Plank

instructions:
1. Set the suspension handles to about chest height and stand facing the anchor, feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Hold the handles with a neutral grip and lean back with your arms extended.
3. Pull your chest toward the handles by driving your elbows out to the sides at shoulder height.
4. Squeeze your shoulder blades together until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
5. Extend your arms back to the start with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Exhale as you pull and inhale as you extend.
2. Keep your core tight so your hips do not sag.
3. Lead with your elbows wide to target the rear delts.
4. Keep your shoulders down, away from your ears.
name: Suspension Trainer with Grips Rear Delt Row

instructions:
1. Set the suspension handles to about knee height and place your feet in them.
2. Get into a plank with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width and your body straight.
3. Brace your core and bend your knees, drawing them toward your chest while lifting your hips.
4. Continue until your hips are fully bent and your knees are close to your chest.
5. Extend your legs back to the plank position with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Exhale as you pull your knees in and inhale as you extend.
2. Start with a small range and increase it as you get stronger.
3. Keep your shoulders down, away from your ears.
4. Move slowly to keep the straps from swinging.
name: Suspension Trainer with Grips Reverse Ab Rollout

instructions:
1. Set the suspension handles low and grasp them with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
2. Lean back with arms extended, body straight, and feet together.
3. Brace your core to hold a straight line from head to heels.
4. Pull your chest toward the handles by bending your elbows and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
5. Extend your arms to lower back to the start with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Move with a steady, controlled tempo.
2. Exhale as you pull up and inhale as you lower.
3. Keep your wrists under your shoulders for alignment.
4. Drive with your back, not just your arms.
name: Suspension Trainer with Grips Reverse Push-up

instructions:
1. Set one suspension handle to about chest height and stand facing the anchor.
2. Hold the handle with an overhand grip and lean back, arm extended, feet shoulder-width apart.
3. Pull your chest toward the handle by driving your elbow out to the side at shoulder height.
4. Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine until your upper arm is parallel to the floor.
5. Extend your arm back to the start with control, then switch sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Lead with the rear delt and upper back, not just the arm.
2. Keep your shoulders down, away from your ears.
3. Exhale as you pull and inhale as you extend.
4. Brace your core to resist twisting toward the working side.
name: Suspension Trainer with Grips Single Arm Rear Delt Row
